title.zh: 贪污、贩毒及其他严重罪行（利益没收）（第 45 条下的披露）条例 2024
title.en: Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) (Disclosure under Section 45) Regulations 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) (Disclosure under Section 45) Regulations 2024 and come into operation on 1 August 2024.

heading.en: Means of disclosure under section 45 of Act

text.en:
3. A disclosure made under section 45(1) of the Act must be made —
(a)electronically by using SONAR; or
(b)where SONAR is unavailable to the public, by submitting the disclosure —
(i)by email to STRO@spf.gov.sg; and
(ii)in the form specified for this purpose on the Office website.
